archetypes.name: dyn-hook-guard
archetypes.rationale: Hook carve-outs and clone-scoping need careful false-positive and bypass review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the hook-bg-poll-guard changes for exact command matching, clone-correlation boundaries, and marker-step binding. Pay special attention to whether Step 3 probes can satisfy Step 5 waits, whether tasks/*.output Bash reads are scoped correctly, and whether mutation or appended-probe bypasses remain denied. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
